2025 report

Published

February 28, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the 2025 survey year across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 3,809 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 5 benchmark sites in 4 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: March 2025 to November 2025). These surveys captured 55 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 22 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 6,184 cards across 170 sites, with 9.5% showing evidence of mouse activity (587 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 1441 transects across 151 sites (survey period: December 2024 to November 2025), detecting active burrows in 4.4% of transects (total: 122 active burrows).
